pages.title: [Chat composer]
pages.purpose: Prompt composer docked at the bottom of ChatScreen: text field, inline slash/@ suggestions, staged attachments and references, delivery toggle, tools button, model chip, full-screen editor button and Send/Stop.

elements.label: /<command slash>  <description>
elements.effect: Inline slash suggestion (shown while the draft is exactly "/<query>"); calls onSelectCommand -> ChatScreen._selectChatCommand (chat_screen.dart:5074): a server command replaces the draft with "/<name> " and refocuses; a mobile command clears the slash draft and runs _runMobileCommand(action), which may navigate (see notes).
gates: at most 1 row when compact, else 5

elements.label: Show all commands
elements.effect: Calls onOpenCommands -> ChatScreen._openCommandLauncher() which opens the composer tools sheet on the Commands tab.

elements.label: @<agent id>  <description|Delegate>
elements.effect: Inline @-mention suggestion; calls onSelectAgent -> ChatScreen._insertAgentMention(agent) (chat_screen.dart:2695) which inserts the @agent mention into the draft.

elements.label: Show all subagents
elements.effect: Calls onOpenAgents -> ChatScreen._openCommandLauncher(initialTab: _ComposerToolTab.agents).

elements.label: Steer | Queue (SegmentedButton)
elements.key: composer-delivery-steer / composer-delivery-queue (segment label keys); container composer-delivery-control
elements.effect: onSelectionChanged -> onDeliveryChanged(selection.single); host does setState(() => _delivery = delivery), changing whether Send steers the running turn or queues after it.
gates: canChooseDelivery (host: _conn.supportsInbox) && onDeliveryChanged != null; otherwise a non-interactive _QueueHint (key composer-queue-hint) is shown

elements.label: Remove reference {name}
elements.effect: Removes one staged review reference chip; calls onRemoveReference(reference) (host callback in ChatScreen, null disables the button). References are in-memory only.

elements.label: <attachment filename> (tooltip: Preview {name})
elements.effect: Opens showFilePreviewSheet(context, FilePreviewData.fromDataUrl(name, mimeType, url)) for the pending attachment.

elements.label: Remove attachment {name} / Remove reference @{name}
elements.effect: Calls onRemoveAttachment(attachment); host removes the pending attachment from the draft.

elements.label: Restore original draft
elements.effect: Calls onRestoreHistoryDraft -> ChatScreen._restoreHistoryDraft() (chat_screen.dart:917), putting back the draft that prompt-history navigation replaced.

elements.label: Ask OpenCode…
elements.effect: Multiline prompt draft bound to ChatScreen._composer; typing "/" or "@" drives the inline suggestions; IME image insertion calls onContentInserted -> _handleInsertedContent.

elements.label: Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter (desktop: Enter, Numpad Enter)
elements.effect: CallbackShortcuts -> _submitFromKeyboard(): calls onSend (ChatScreen._send) when _hasPrompt && !sending && !shelfBusy && (!busy || canSendWhileBusy).
gates: plain Enter / numpadEnter only when desktopInteractions

elements.label: Add. Hold to attach a file / Prompt tools
elements.effect: _openTool(context): opens the Prompt tools sheet, then dispatches the chosen _PromptTool to the matching host callback after the sheet closes. No-op when isolated || shelfBusy || conversationMode.

elements.label: <agent · model · variant> | Choose model (tooltip: Model and agent: {model}. Tap to change.{cost})
elements.effect: Calls onChooseModel; host calls showModelPicker(context, applyScope: _modelApplyScope, sessionID: widget.sessionID) unless _conn.isIsolated.
gates: collapses to an icon when narrower than 80 scaled px

elements.label: Open full-screen prompt editor
elements.effect: Calls onOpenEditor -> ChatScreen._openPromptEditor() (chat_screen.dart:3319) which pushes _PromptEditorScreen with the current draft.

elements.label: Stop
elements.effect: _stop(): dismisses tooltips then onStop -> ChatScreen._abort() (chat_screen.dart:3383) aborting the running turn. Rendered with key chat-send-button when busy && !canSendWhileBusy (line 1188), or as chat-stop-button beside Send when busy && canSendWhileBusy (line 1227).

elements.label: Send | Send after this run | Queue after this run | Send now and steer this run
elements.effect: onSend -> ChatScreen._send() (chat_screen.dart:2425); while busy the tooltip reflects the delivery mode (line 1238). Shows a spinner while sending.

elements.label: Switch model for this session
elements.effect: PopupMenuButton (opens overflow menu) passed by ChatScreen._modelCycleButton() (chat_screen.dart:5013) as the composer modelSwitch slot beside the model chip.

elements.label: Next recent model · F2
elements.effect: onSelected("next") -> onCycle(reverse: false, favoritesOnly: false) -> ChatScreen._cycleModel (chat_screen.dart:4982) switching the session model.

elements.label: Previous recent model · Shift+F2
elements.effect: onSelected("previous") -> onCycle(reverse: true, favoritesOnly: false) -> ChatScreen._cycleModel.

elements.label: Next favorite model
elements.effect: onSelected("favorite") -> onCycle(reverse: false, favoritesOnly: true) -> ChatScreen._cycleModel.

elements.label: Arrow Up (caret at start) / Arrow Down (caret at end)
elements.effect: isPromptHistoryKey(event, value, suggestionsOpen:) gates ChatScreen._navigatePromptHistory (chat_screen.dart:893, installed as _focus.onKeyEvent at :573); PromptHistoryNavigation.move() swaps the draft for older/newer sent prompts and keeps the original for "Restore original draft".
gates: selection collapsed and no active IME composing range

pages.title: Prompt tools
pages.purpose: One sheet behind the composer "+" button listing commands, attach, photo, voice, advanced and prompt-shelf tools; each tile pops with a _PromptTool that _ChatComposer._openTool dispatches to a ChatScreen callback.

elements.label: Commands and agents
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.commands; _openTool calls onOpenCommands -> ChatScreen._openCommandLauncher().

elements.label: Attach file
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.attach; _openTool calls onAttach -> ChatScreen._pickAttachment() (system file picker, adds a PromptAttachment).

elements.label: Photo library
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.gallery; onPhotoLibrary -> ChatScreen._pickPhoto(ImageSource.gallery).

elements.label: Take photo
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.camera; onCamera -> ChatScreen._pickPhoto(ImageSource.camera).

elements.label: Voice input
elements.effect: onVoice -> ChatScreen._openVoice(): the voice model setup sheet when no model is ready; otherwise voice is a composer mode (slice-P10.3, 3273d7ef) and dictation lands in the draft; no voice sheet opens.

elements.label: More tools
elements.effect: ExpansionTile: expands the Add web source / Voice conversation rows.

elements.label: Add web source
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.webSources; onWebSources -> ChatScreen._addWebSources() (chat_screen.dart:2878) pushes WebSourcesScreen(controller: _conn).

elements.label: Voice conversation
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.conversation; onConversation -> ChatScreen._startVoiceConversation() switching the chat into voice conversation mode.

elements.label: Prompts
elements.effect: ExpansionTile: expands the prompt history / drafts / stash / clear rows.

elements.label: Reuse a prompt
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.history; onReusePrompt -> ChatScreen._reusePrompt() (chat_screen.dart:875) opens _PromptHistorySheet and appends the chosen prompt to the draft.

elements.label: Save prompt for later
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.stash; onStashPrompt -> ChatScreen._stashCurrentPrompt() (chat_screen.dart:953) -> _conn.savePromptStash(snapshot, locationRevision).
gates: enabled only when canStash (_hasPrompt && onStashPrompt != null)

elements.label: Saved prompts
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.saved; onOpenStash -> ChatScreen._openPromptStash() (chat_screen.dart:1005) opens _PromptStashSheet.

elements.label: Clear draft text
elements.effect: Pops _PromptTool.clearText; onClearText -> ChatScreen._clearDraftText() (chat_screen.dart:1164) clears the composer text and shows a snackbar.

pages.title: Composer tools
pages.purpose: Searchable sheet with a Commands tab (mobile actions plus server slash commands) and a Delegate tab (server subagents to @-mention).

elements.label: Close composer tools
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context).

elements.label: Commands | Delegate
elements.effect: TabBar on _tabs; _onTabChanged clears the search and rebuilds.

elements.label: Find a command or action | Find a subagent
elements.effect: onChanged -> setState; filters commands via _ChatCommand.matchesQuery/scoreFor or agents by id/description.

elements.label: Clear search
elements.effect: _search.clear(); setState.

elements.label: Retry server commands
elements.effect: _refresh(): on the Commands tab awaits widget.onRefresh (ChatScreen._loadServerCommands), otherwise controller.refreshCatalog().

elements.label: /<slash> <aliases> mobile|server — <description>
elements.effect: onSelected(command): host unfocuses, pops the sheet, then ChatScreen._selectChatCommand(command): server commands prefill "/<name> " in the composer; mobile commands run _executeMobileCommand(action), which may navigate or mutate (full action list in notes).

elements.label: <search index entry title> (In <parent screen>)
elements.effect: Listed under 'Go to' while the Commands tab's search has text: searchEntries(l10n, SearchScope.of(context, controller), query). Tap pops the sheet and runs entry.open from the route below it (a settings screen is pushed over the conversation; a tab result returns to the shell).
gates: each entry's own gate in lib/ui/search/search_index.dart

elements.label: Refresh
elements.effect: onRefresh -> _refresh() -> controller.refreshCatalog().

elements.label: @<agent id> — <description|Delegate this prompt> <model>
elements.effect: onSelected(agent) -> widget.onAgentSelected: host pops the sheet and calls ChatScreen._insertAgentMention(agent) (ignored when !_supportsPromptAgentMentions).

pages.title: Prompt editor
pages.purpose: Full-screen editor for the composer draft and its attachments; Done returns the edited value to ChatScreen, closing a dirty editor asks to discard.

elements.label: Close prompt editor
elements.effect: _cancel(): pops immediately when not dirty, otherwise opens the discard confirm sheet; system back goes through the same path via PopScope.onPopInvokedWithResult (line 108).

elements.label: Attach file | Attachment limit reached
elements.effect: _addAttachment(): awaits widget.chooseAttachment(_attachments) (host file chooser) and appends the result; errors go to showProductError.

elements.label: Use in draft
elements.effect: _save(): Navigator.pop with _PromptEditorResult(value, attachments); ChatScreen._openPromptEditor applies it to the composer.

elements.label: <attachment filename> (tooltip: Preview {name})
elements.effect: _PendingAttachmentChip.openPreview -> showFilePreviewSheet(context, FilePreviewData.fromDataUrl(...)).

elements.label: Remove {name}
elements.effect: setState(() => _attachments.removeAt(index)) (local until Done).

elements.label: Write your OpenCode prompt…
elements.effect: Autofocused expanding multiline field on a local TextEditingController seeded from the composer value.

pages.title: Discard prompt changes?
pages.purpose: Confirm sheet shown when closing a dirty prompt editor.

reachedFrom.trigger: system back while the prompt editor is dirty (PopScope, prompt_editor.dart:108)

elements.label: Discard
elements.effect: showConfirmSheet returns true; _cancel pops the editor without a result so the composer keeps its original draft and attachments.

elements.label: Keep editing
elements.effect: Closes the sheet and stays in the editor.

pages.title: Reuse a prompt
pages.purpose: Searchable list of prompts already sent in this conversation; picking one appends its text to the draft.

elements.label: Search recent prompts
elements.effect: onChanged -> setState(_query = value.trim().toLowerCase()) filtering the list.

elements.label: <prompt text>
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, matches[index]); ChatScreen._reusePrompt appends the text to the composer draft and refocuses.

pages.title: Saved prompts
pages.purpose: Saved prompts on this device for this server, newest first: a row tap restores into the draft; Delete in the row menu happens at once with Undo (chat-3).

elements.label: Search saved prompts
elements.effect: onChanged -> setState(_query = value); filters by text, attachment names, directory, workspace and reference descriptions.

elements.label: Clear search
elements.effect: _search.clear(); setState(_query = "").

elements.label: Retry
elements.effect: _prepare() -> controller.preparePromptStash(locationRevision: widget.location) then re-reads controller.promptStash.

elements.label: Restore to draft (row tap or row menu)
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, prompt); ChatScreen._openPromptStash (chat_screen.dart:1049-1160) then restores attachments via _conn.restorePromptStashAttachments, may ask showConfirmSheet ("promptAttachmentsUnavailable" or "promptRestoreTitle" when a draft exists), stashes the current draft, applies the prompt and calls _conn.removePromptStash.

elements.label: Delete saved prompt
elements.effect: Row menu item: the row leaves at once and "Saved prompt deleted · Undo" shows; removePromptStash runs when the Undo window closes.

pages.title: [Transcript find bar]
pages.purpose: In-conversation search bar shown above the transcript in ChatScreen while _findOpen.

elements.label: Search conversation
elements.effect: onChanged -> ChatScreen._changeFind; onSubmitted -> onNext (ChatScreen._navigateFind(1)).

elements.label: Close search
elements.effect: onClose -> ChatScreen._closeFind.

elements.label: Esc
elements.effect: CallbackShortcuts escape -> onClose (ChatScreen._closeFind).

elements.label: Previous match
elements.effect: onPrevious -> ChatScreen._navigateFind(-1).

elements.label: Next match
elements.effect: onNext -> ChatScreen._navigateFind(1).

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: onCancelLoading -> host setState(() => _findAllLoading = false) stopping the all-history search.

elements.label: Search all history | Reload recent history
elements.effect: onLoadOlder -> ChatScreen._searchAllHistory loading older pages to search them; label is "Reload recent history" when needsReload (_olderNeedsReload || _resetHistoryOnLoad).

pages.title: Use the system speech engine?
pages.purpose: One-time consent before a reply is handed to the system text-to-speech engine.

elements.label: Choose voice
elements.effect: Sets _readAloudConsented = true, creates the ReadAloudController and continues to the voice picker when no voice is chosen yet.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Declines; _ensureSpeechReady returns false and nothing is spoken.

pages.title: Choose a reading voice
pages.purpose: Lists the offline system voices returned by ReadAloudController.voices(); the choice is kept for the session scope.

elements.label: <voice label> / <locale>
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, voice); sets _readAloudVoiceID and _readReply then calls speech.speak(sessionID/messageID, prose, voiceID).

pages.title: [Chat keyboard shortcuts: model cycle / background]
pages.purpose: Focus wrapper around the whole ChatScreen that handles hardware-keyboard shortcuts while the chat route is current.

elements.label: F2
elements.effect: onCycle(reverse: false, favoritesOnly: false) -> ChatScreen._cycleModel: next recent model for the session.

elements.label: Shift+F2
elements.effect: onCycle(reverse: true, favoritesOnly: false) -> ChatScreen._cycleModel: previous recent model.

elements.label: Ctrl+B
elements.effect: onBackground -> ChatScreen._backgroundRunningWork.

pages.title: [Transcript display toggles]
pages.purpose: Two switches for transcript display preferences, embedded in the session menu sheet.

elements.label: Reasoning
elements.effect: _setReasoning(value) -> connection.setTranscriptReasoningExpanded(value) (connProvider).

elements.label: Timestamps & usage
elements.effect: _setTimestamps(value) -> connection.setTranscriptTimestampsVisible(value).

pages.title: [Prompt error banner]
pages.purpose: Live-region banner above the transcript showing the last failed prompt send with dismiss, details and a model fix.

elements.label: Dismiss prompt error
elements.effect: onDismiss -> host setState(() => _promptError = null).

elements.label: Details
elements.effect: showDialog with an AlertDialog holding the full selectable error text.

elements.label: Choose model
elements.effect: onChooseModel -> host showModelPicker(context, applyScope: _modelApplyScope, sessionID: widget.sessionID).

pages.title: Error details
pages.purpose: Full server error text (stack trace included) for a failed prompt, selectable monospace.

elements.label: Close
elements.effect: Navigator.of(context).pop().

pages.title: [Subagent session banner: "Subagent · {count}"]
pages.purpose: Banner shown in a delegated (child) session with links to the parent session and the sibling list.

elements.label: Open parent session
elements.effect: onParent -> ChatScreen._openParentSession() -> _openRelatedSession(parent): _conn.selectLocationForExistingSession then pushReplacementNamed("/chat/<parent id>").

elements.label: Show all subagent sessions
elements.effect: onAll -> ChatScreen._showSubagents() (chat_screen.dart:5703) pushes SessionRelationsScreen.

pages.title: [Shared session banner: "Shared: anyone with the link can view"]
pages.purpose: Banner shown while the session has a public share URL.

elements.label: Copy share link
elements.effect: Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: url)).

elements.label: Stop sharing
elements.effect: onStop -> ChatScreen._stopSharing() (chat_screen.dart:3455): repository.unshareSession(widget.sessionID), clears _localShareUrl, _conn.refreshSessions(). No confirmation.

pages.title: [Chat transcript: messages, empty state, floating pills]
pages.purpose: Transcript body of ChatScreen: the empty-state suggestions, each rendered message (user bubble, assistant prose, tool groups, reasoning, attachments, error cards, v2 notices and background-agent results) and the floating jump/timeline pills.

elements.label: Explain the {name} project | What changed recently? | Find and fix a bug | List what's in this directory
elements.effect: onSuggestion(suggestion) -> ChatScreen._insertSuggestion, inserting the text into the composer.

elements.label: Jump to latest
elements.effect: onTap -> ChatScreen._jumpToLatest scrolling the transcript to the newest message.
gates: host shows it while scrolled away from the latest message (_awayFromLatest)

elements.label: {count} earlier messages
elements.effect: onTap -> ChatScreen._openTimeline() (chat_screen.dart:3496) opening the timeline sheet.
gates: _awayFromLatest and at least one message above the viewport

elements.label: <notice header> (compaction / skill / failure notice)
elements.effect: TranscriptNotice: setState(() => _open = !_open) expanding the body (markdown for compaction summaries).
gates: v2 tagged message (v2:notice / v2:compaction, via V2TranscriptRow)

elements.label: Open subagent session
elements.effect: widget.onOpenChild(result.childID) -> ChatScreen._openSubagentSession(id, requireChild: ...) -> pushReplacementNamed("/chat/<child id>").

elements.label: Server message details
elements.effect: setState(() => _details = !_details) revealing the raw protocol text.

elements.label: Tools | Running tools | Explored | Exploring — <summary>
elements.effect: _toggle(): flips _expanded and records the choice in widget.expansionStore["tools:<id>"]; expanded groups render ToolCard rows (lib/ui/widgets tool card, not in this area) with onAttachFile/onDownloadFile/onOpenSession passed through.
gates: assistant message with a grouped tool run (_groupAssistantParts)

elements.label: <option from a ```choices block>
elements.effect: MarkdownText.onChoice -> _insertChoice: ChatScreen._insertSuggestion(option); without a ChatScreen ancestor copies to the clipboard and shows "Copied. Paste it into the composer" snackbar.
gates: assistant text part containing a choices block

elements.label: Reasoning (tap to expand) (semantics: Expand/Collapse reasoning details)
elements.effect: setState(_open = !_open) and _persist(_open) into the expansion store.
gates: reasoning part whose text is not short (_isShort renders short reasoning inline without a toggle)

elements.label: <attachment filename> (tooltip: Preview attachment)
elements.effect: openPreview -> showFilePreviewSheet(context, FilePreviewData.fromDataUrl(name, mimeType, url)).

elements.label: [long-press on a message]
elements.effect: onLongPress -> ChatScreen._showMessageActions(m) (chat_screen.dart:3959) opening the message actions sheet (copy, fork, revert, delete, read aloud).

elements.label: Message actions
elements.effect: Same callback as long-press: ChatScreen._showMessageActions(m).

elements.label: [right-click on a message]
elements.effect: ContextMenuRegion(actions: contextActions) -> ChatScreen._messageContextActions(m): desktop menu mirroring the message actions sheet; entries are built in chat_screen.dart.

elements.label: Details
elements.effect: _ErrorActionCard._showDetails: AlertDialog with the full server error text.

elements.label: Choose model
elements.effect: onAction = onChooseModel -> host showModelPicker(context, applyScope: _modelApplyScope, sessionID: widget.sessionID).

elements.label: Compact session
elements.effect: onAction = onCompact -> ChatScreen._compact() summarizing the session.

elements.label: Open providers
elements.effect: onAction = onOpenProviders -> ChatScreen._openProviders() (chat_screen.dart:4152) pushes IntegrationsScreen(controller: _conn).

elements.label: Continue
elements.effect: onAction = onContinue -> ChatScreen._continueTruncated() sending a "Continue" prompt after an output-length cut.

pages.title: Error details
pages.purpose: Full server error text for a failed assistant message.

elements.label: Close
elements.effect: Navigator.of(context).pop().

pages.title: [Pending sends strip]
pages.purpose: List between transcript and composer of offline queued drafts and OpenCode 2 inbox items that have not reached the agent yet.

elements.label: Send again
elements.effect: onResend(entry) -> ChatScreen._resendQueuedPrompt: explicit resend of a dispatched-but-unconfirmed draft.

elements.label: Edit draft
elements.effect: onEdit(entry) -> ChatScreen._editQueuedPrompt: moves the queued draft back into the composer.

elements.label: Discard draft
elements.effect: onDiscard(entry) -> ChatScreen._discardQueuedPrompt (chat_screen.dart:2293) which confirms through showConfirmSheet before removing the queued prompt.

elements.label: Wait for this run instead
elements.effect: onFlipDelivery(item) -> ChatScreen._flipInboxDelivery: changes the inbox item from steer to queue.

elements.label: Send now and steer instead
elements.effect: onFlipDelivery(item) -> ChatScreen._flipInboxDelivery: changes the inbox item from queue to steer.

elements.label: Cancel and return to the composer
elements.effect: onCancelInbox(item) -> ChatScreen._cancelInboxSend: cancels the server inbox item and restores its text to the composer.

pages.title: [One-time tip above the composer]
pages.purpose: The single inline slot for the four conversation nudges (approvals, review changes, leave and be told, compact), drawn with the shared NudgeCard (lib/ui/widgets/nudge_card.dart). Triggers live in lib/state/conversation_nudges.dart.

reachedFrom.trigger: ConversationNudgeWatcher offers a nudge at its moment (third permission request of one kind answered; first finished run that changed files; 60 s wait with finished-run notifications ready; context usage >= 80%)

gates: registry.firstReplySeen (never during first run before the first reply)
each nudge is offered at most once ever (NudgeRegistry, oc.nudges.shown); never two at once; hidden while _nudgeSuppressed (pending permission/question/form, retry banner)

elements.label: Approvals
elements.effect: Card text 'Asked for “{action}” 3 times: this conversation can approve requests for you.'; dismisses the nudge, then showSessionApprovalsSheet(context, controller: _conn, sessionID).
gates: third distinct permission request of one kind in this conversation this app run

elements.label: Review changes
elements.effect: Card text 'This run changed files: review what changed before you continue.'; dismisses the nudge, then _showDiff() (the same review the app bar opens).
gates: busy→idle edge with runChangedFiles(_messages) or session.summary.files > 0

elements.label: Compact conversation
elements.effect: Card text 'The context is {percent}% full: compact to keep going.'; dismisses the nudge, then _compact() (the existing compact action).

elements.label: Got it
elements.effect: Card text 'You can leave: this phone tells you when the run is done.'; dismisses the nudge.
gates: conversation open and busy for 60 s
controller.finishedRunNotificationsReady (platform, background connection on, notification permission granted, finished-run rule on, not quiet hours)

notPages.reason: TranscriptHighlight (InheritedWidget that tints find matches inside spans) and TranscriptMatchExcerpt (static excerpt card); no surface and no interactive element.

presentConnectionForm is glue only: it calls presentForm (lib/ui/widgets/form_renderer.dart, another agent) and routes submit/cancel to connection.replyForm / connection.cancelForm, plus a snackbar 'Already answered elsewhere'. Callers: chat_screen.dart:4451, activity_screen.dart:148/807, profile_monitor_screen.dart:70, return_brief_panel.dart:77.

notes: command_launcher.dart:566 / composer inline rows: a mobile _ChatCommand runs ChatScreen._executeMobileCommand (chat_screen.dart:5098, not my file). Its targets by _ChatCommandAction: newSession -> _conn.createSession + pushReplacementNamed("/chat/<id>"); sessions -> GlobalSessionsScreen; workspaces -> HomeScreen(initialTab: 0); files -> FilesScreen; projectHealth -> ProjectHealthScreen; move/warp -> showSessionDestinationSheet; promptEditor -> _PromptEditorScreen; terminal -> TerminalScreen; model -> showModelPicker; integrations -> IntegrationsScreen; organization -> showConsoleOrganizationSheet; skills -> SkillsScreen; tools -> ToolsScreen; references -> ReferencesScreen; status -> SettingsScreen; diagnostics -> AppDiagnosticsScreen; appearance -> showAppearancePicker; diff/context/share/unshare/rename/timeline/fork/compact/thinking/timestamps/undo/redo/copy/export/help -> ChatScreen helper methods. The command list itself (_chatCommands, gating per capability) lives in chat_screen.dart; the chat-screen owner should emit those edges.
